Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Sabé]] was sent on a '''mission''' to<ref name="Vader 29" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|vanguard-squadron|Vanguard Squadron}}</ref> [[Brentaal IV]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] to [[Death|assassinate]] the [[Skakoan]]<ref name="Vader 29" /> nationalist<ref name="Vader 28" /> [[Jul Tambor]] who was attempting to [[Uprising on Skako Minor|overthrow]] the [[Skakoan Council]] on [[Skako Minor]]. Unable to convince him to abandon his stand against the Empire when she expressed her fear of what Vader would do to his people in retaliation, Sabé shot Tambor<ref name="Vader 29" /> in a non-fatal manner to prevent his attack on the [[Imperial garrison (Skako Minor)|Imperial garrison]] on Skako Minor. When Sabé expressed her reasoning, Tambor resolved to kill Vader himself before he moved to reclaim Skako Minor, capturing Sabé to lure Vader to him.<ref name="Vader 30" />
